description: Header file defining the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) Heap Allocator implementation for buffer management, including classes, structs, and constants related to Metal heap and buffer handling in a PyTorch MPS context.

classes.name: BufferBlock
classes.description: Represents a Metal buffer with associated metadata, including size, shape, and synchronization events.

classes.name: HeapBlock
classes.description: Manages a Metal heap, including creation, buffer allocation, and size tracking.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Pools of buffers categorized by usage and size, managing heap and buffer lists.

classes.name: MPSHeapAllocatorImpl
classes.description: Implements the allocator interface for managing Metal buffers and heaps, including allocation, deallocation, and cache management.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates a Metal buffer of specified size and usage.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a buffer and returns it to the pool.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Releases all cached buffers and heaps.

methods.name: isSharedBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer was allocated from the shared pool.

methods.name: getUnalignedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the unaligned size of a buffer.

methods.name: setBufferShape
methods.description: Sets the shape metadata for a buffer.

methods.name: getBufferShape
methods.description: Retrieves the shape metadata of a buffer.

methods.name: getBufferId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of a buffer.

methods.name: allocScalarBufferWithValue
methods.description: Allocates a buffer initialized with a scalar value for GPU import.

methods.name: getSharedBufferPtr
methods.description: Returns a CPU pointer and retain count for a shared buffer.

methods.name: recordEvents
methods.description: Records GPU/CPU synchronization events for buffers.

methods.name: waitForEvents
methods.description: Waits for GPU events to complete on shared buffers.

methods.name: getLowWatermarkValue
methods.description: Returns current memory usage relative to low watermark.

methods.name: setLowWatermarkRatio
methods.description: Sets the ratio for low watermark memory limit.

methods.name: setHighWatermarkRatio
methods.description: Sets the ratio for high watermark memory limit.

methods.name: format_size
methods.description: Formats a size in bytes into a human-readable string.
